items.name: Butter Croissant
items.description: Golden pastry with soft, flaky layers and a rich buttery flavour. For any additional condiments, please ask in-store. Please check the label for allergens.
items.heard: Butter Croissant: Golden pastry with soft, flaky layers and a rich buttery flavour. For any additional condiments, please ask in-store. Please check the label for allergens.. Also ordered as 'a croissant', 'plain croissant'. Not the almond croissant and not the ham and cheddar croissant.

items.heard: Almond Croissant: A butter croissant filled with an almond filling, topped with toasted flaked almonds and dusted with powdered sugar.. Also ordered as 'an almond croissant'.

items.name: Chai Latte
items.description: The warm, aromatic flavours of chai tea have their roots in the ancient Ayurvedic tradition of India, where roadside tea merchants can be found preparing black tea with traditional healing spices like cardamom, cinnamon and black pepper. Featuring ingredients gathered from around the globe, our version of this beloved beverage is wonderfully sweet and spicy – and every bit as soothing.
items.heard: Chai Latte: The warm, aromatic flavours of chai tea have their roots in the ancient Ayurvedic tradition of India, where roadside tea merchants can be found preparing black tea with traditional healing spices like cardamom, cinnamon and black pepper. Featuring ingredients gathered from around the globe, our version of this beloved beverage is wonderfully sweet and spicy – and every bit as soothing. Also ordered as 'a chai', 'chai latte', 'chai tea latte'. Can be hot or iced.
